name: Balaguer (Spain)
description: Divided per saltire, the hoist and fly triangles chequy of white and black and the upper and lower triangles of the four red bars of Aragon on yellow.
history: Municipal flag of Balaguer; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: upper and lower triangles bearing the bars of Aragon
bars of Aragon in the upper and lower triangles
